author: GamingBolt
description:
While Resident Evil 0 focused on STARS’ Bravo Team investigating the Eclipse Express, Resident Evil 1 revolves around Alpha Team, who are dispatched to the Arklay Mountains after RPD loses contact with Bravo. Comprising the Alpha Team are protagonists Chris Redfield and Jill Valentine, Barry Burton, Brad Vickers, and Joseph Frost, and of course, the captain of STARS and the leader of Alpha Team himself, Albert Wesker.

Resident Evil 1 kicks off with Alpha Team flying their chopper over the Arklay Mountains, where they spot Bravo Team’s crashed chopper in the forest and decide to land and investigate.

title: Resident Evil 1 FULL STORY EXPLAINED - Part 3 - Before You Play Resident Evil Requiem

author: GamingBolt
description:
Racing games are always an important part of the gaming landscape and we've got quite a few bangers coming our way in 2026. From arcade racers that are designed to thrill to the virtual debut of pod racing from Star Wars, it's a year of high-octane fun and more than a few fender benders thanks to a solid line up of racing sims. 

There's something for everyone, as both purists and more casual racers have a lot to look forward to. There’s returning favorites coming up against some bold new projects in a year that’s poised to keep the racers in us entertained for many an hour.
title: 15 NEW Racing Games of 2026 And Beyond [PS5, Xbox Series X | S, Switch 2, PC]

author: GamingBolt
description:
It's easy to forget how Resident Evil 5 switched things up for the franchise back in the day. But as Requiem inches ever closer to its final release, we are reminded of a time when Chris was forced to leave the methodical approach that the franchise's protagonists were encouraged to take, instead taking the threats he encountered head on. 

But that doesn't mean that the mechanics that made Resident Evil so enjoyable in the first place weren't there. Indeed, they were part of why the game's action-heavy format clicked so well. RE5 was a blend of ideas old and new, and was a bold game that largely clicked as a result. Join us as we take a fond look at a title that might have been anathema to purists, but a fun one to those who gave it a chance.
title: Resident Evil 5 Is WAY BETTER Than People Admit
